name: Side forearm plank
definition: Lie on one side and raise the trunk on the lower forearm and stacked feet, with knees extended. Maintain the side-support position without deliberately bending the trunk.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Lie on one side and raise the trunk on the lower forearm and stacked feet, with knees extended.
value.movement: Maintain the side-support position without deliberately bending the trunk.
value.finish: Return to the floor to end the hold.
value.range_of_motion: No intended trunk excursion; keep the chosen straight-leg support configuration.
